scandinavian-drls.note: Rear lamp channels 0567/0568 get a DRL (0x14) function in slot C at dimming 70. Assumes slot C is free (true on the Kushaq 2Q0937089D BCM).

drl-on-with-auto.note: DRL off when the light switch is at 0, so DRL runs only in AUTO. New BCM 0A58 byte4 bit2, old 0D02 byte1 bit2.

us-style-turn-lights.note: Front turn lamps 0550/0551 also run as position lamps at the vendor fixed 30% level (halogen turn bulbs).

comfort-turn-signals.note: Live-verified on 2Q0937089D: 0A5E byte0 bits1-2 plus byte0 bit4=1 (vendor TurnLightsPoliteBlinks). MQB family uses el-comfort-turn-signals, the same routine with the vendor Unit09 BCM-generation switch (old BCM 0D00 byte0 bits1-2 + bit7=1). The vendor has no Off option.

headlight-notification.note: Dashboard.cs DisableTurnOnLightWarning_09: Enable (= hide the warning) clears 0A57 byte1 bits3-4; Disable sets them (value 3).

coming-home-lights-operation.note: New BCM 0A57 ops derived from ComingHomeActivation (also sets CH duration 60 s).

fog-lights-with-high-beam.note: Fog lamp channels 055C/055D get the high-beam function in slot G, so the fogs light together with high beam.

drl-activation-deactivation.note: 0A58 byte4 bits0-1 (old 0D02 byte1 bits0-1), ExteriorLights.cs DrivingLightsByDay.

cornering-lights.note: 3 parts: 055C/055D FunctionB = corner left/right, plus 0D1D corner parameters (restored from backup on Off).

position-lights-with-turn-signals.note: 0567/0568 slot G = turn left/right (02/04) with dimming-direction GH = minimize. Single vendor configuration.

auto-headlights-settings.note: Light sensor sensitivity: Sensitive = turns on earlier.

headlight-washer.note: Washes counter (0A73 byte1 / old 0D05 byte0). No vendor installed/off bit exists, so OFF is not available.

headlight-washer-activation-delay.note: Free value in ms, step 10 ms (0A73 byte2 x10). 0.5-2.5 s = 500-2500.

headlight-washer-activation-time.note: Free value in ms, step 10 ms (0A73 byte3 x10).

drl-with-fog-lights.note: Front fog lamps get the daytime running light function in slot C at 100%. Needs slot C free (true on the Kushaq 2Q0937089D BCM); otherwise the plan refuses.

third-brake-light-when-trunk-open.note: 0566 (3rd brake light) slot C = 0x21 tailgate open at 100%. Needs A = 0x18 (brake light) and slots C/D free; otherwise the plan refuses.

third-brake-light-with-drl.note: 0566 slot E = 0x14 DRL at 10%, maximise (braking still goes to full). Needs A = 0x18 and slots E/F free.

third-brake-light-with-coming-leaving-ho.note: 0566 slot G = 0x1E coming/leaving home at 100%. Needs A = 0x18 and slots G/H free.

brake-lights-when-trunk-open.note: 0564/0565 (brake lights) slot C = 0x21 tailgate open at 100%. Needs A = 0x18 and slots C/D free on each lamp.

taillights-when-trunk-open.note: 0567/0568 (tail lights) slot E = 0x21 tailgate open at 100% (C is Scandinavian DRL, G the wink). Needs A = 0x08 and slots E/F free.

license-plate-lights-with-trunk-open.note: 0569 (number-plate light) slot C = 0x21 tailgate open: 100% maximise (on) or 0% minimise (off). Default clears slot C. Needs slots C/D free.

license-plate-lights-with-drl.note: 0569 slot E = 0x14 DRL at 100%. Needs slots E/F free.

turn-signals-with-ch-lh.note: 0550/0551 (front turn lamps) slot G = 0x1E coming/leaving home at 100% (D/E belong to US-style). Fixed brightness. Needs A = 0x02/0x04 and slots G/H free.

fogs-off-with-high-beams.note: 055C/055D slot G = high beam L/R (0x0D/0x0E) with dim GH 0 + minimise (byte15 0x80), so the fogs go dark while high beam is on. Refuses while Fog Lights with High Beam or with Flash-to-Pass is on (same slot G/H).

drl-on-with-parking-lights.note: 0552/0553 (front side/DRL lamps) dim CD 0x1C -> 0x64, so the position light (C = 0x08) runs at DRL brightness. Needs C = 0x08 and dim CD 0x1C (Kushaq stock); otherwise refuses.
